intro: The Tome of Divinity is an early sacred trial undertaken by initiates of the Light in Ironforge. Dispatched by a mentor in the city's temple, the aspirant must search the outer ring for a person of pure intent and genuine need. Finding the dedicated laborer John Turner, initiates learn that selfless service and compassion are central to walking the path of the Light.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your task then, friend, is to find someone here in Ironforge that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.

Do this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a paladin of the Light. I will remain here in the temple for your return. Other paladins will need my guidance also.

clips.title: Completion
paras: THE ORPHANAGE OF STOR... Oh, sorry, didn't mean to shout at you, sir,
My name is John Turner. How are you?

Good, good, glad to hear things go well for you. I've had a long day of work already, and I miss my wife terribly, but that's the price you have to pay when there are mouths to feed and backs to clothe.
